# Check the distribution of customer_segment
print("Customer segment distribution:\n", sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Calculate conversion rate per segment
conversion_rates = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean().round(4)

print("\nConversion rates by segment:\n", conversion_rates)

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rates.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rates.max()

print(f"\nHighest conversion rate: {best_segment} with {best_rate}")"}
